versions.changelog:
v1.1.0 removes Gemini 图像生成功能和相关文档卡片：

- 移除 Gemini 图像模型脚本（scripts/gemini_image.py）。
- 从模型清单、可用平台、申请引导等描述中删除 Gemini 相关内容。
- 不再提供 Gemini 相关的命令示例及错误处理说明。
- 移除技能介绍文档卡 skill-card.md。

v1.0.0 — Initial release with free text-to-image and text-to-video via multiple platforms.

- Integrates free media generation from Agnes, SenseNova, and Kolors platforms; includes Agnes video generation.
- Bypasses Hunyuan ImageGen to produce images and videos without WorkBuddy watermark.
- Reuses existing platform API keys from models.json; no duplicate plaintext key storage.
- Auto-detects user configuration and workspace paths for full portability—no hardcoded directories.
- Guides first-time users to free API application if no usable keys detected.
- Offers manual model state auditing with dated Markdown reports.
- Note: Gemini image model has no free quota at launch and is excluded from the default model list.
